records.jp: へー、空手！　あのこころがね……
records.en_original: You did karate?! It's a little hard to imagine someone like you fighting...
records.en_auxiliary: You did karate?! It's a little hard to imagine someone like you fighting...
records.en: You did karate?! It's a little hard to imagine someone like you fighting...

records.jp: や、やめてよ……恥ずかしい
records.en_original: S-stop that, it's embarrassing...
records.en_auxiliary: S-stop that, it's embarrassing...
records.en: S-stop that, it's embarrassing...

records.jp: 恥ずかしがることないよ！<CR>内気な自分を変えようと思って始めたんでしょ？
records.en_original: There's nothing embarrassing about that! You started karate to get over your shyness, isn't that right?
records.en_auxiliary: There's nothing embarrassing about that! You started karate to get over your shyness, isn't that right?
records.en: There's nothing embarrassing about that! You started karate to get over your shyness, isn't that right?

records.jp: わたし、いいことだと思うな
records.en_original: I think that's wonderful.
records.en_auxiliary: I think that's wonderful.
records.en: I think that's wonderful.

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃん……ふふっ、ありがとう
records.en_original: Hehe, thanks Shiho...
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, thanks Shiho...
records.en: Hehe, thanks Shiho-chan...

records.jp: わたし、詩帆ちゃんが<CR>転校しちゃった後のことも聞きたいのです
records.en_original: I'd love to hear about what happened after you transferred schools.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd love to hear about what happened after you transferred schools.
records.en: I'd love to hear about what happened after you transferred schools.

records.jp: うーん、どこから話そうかな……。<CR>いろいろあったんだよね
records.en_original: Hmm, where should I begin...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, where should I begin...
records.en: Hmm, where should I begin...

records.jp: 本当に、いろいろあった――
records.en_original: So much happened...
records.en_auxiliary: So much happened...
records.en: So much happened...

records.jp: わたしも、全部思い出せたわけじゃないんだ。<CR>でも、強く記憶に残っていることもある
records.en_original: I don't fully remember all of it... But I do have some particularly strong memories.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't fully remember all of it... But I do have some particularly strong memories.
records.en: I don't fully remember all of it... But I do have some particularly strong memories.

records.jp: ――灰が降った
records.en_original: It rained Ash.
records.en_auxiliary: It rained Ash.
records.en: It rained Ash.

records.jp: 灰……？　噴火でもあったの？
records.en_original: Ash...? Did a volcano erupt?
records.en_auxiliary: Ash...? Did a volcano erupt?
records.en: Ash...? Did a volcano erupt?

records.jp: いえ、形状が似ているので灰という名称になっただけで<CR>火山灰ではないんですが……
records.en_original: No, we called it that just because that's what it looked like. It didn't come from a volcano.
records.en_auxiliary: No, we called it that just because that's what it looked like. It didn't come from a volcano.
records.en: No, we called it that just because that's what it looked like. It didn't come from a volcano.

records.jp: 正体不明の灰は、<CR>人間に“灰病”をもたらしました
records.en_original: Then people started to get Ash Syndrome.
records.en_auxiliary: Then people started to get Ash Syndrome.
records.en: Then people started to get Ash Syndrome.

records.jp: 灰病……灰の病？
records.en_original: Ash Syndrome...? A disease caused by the Ash?
records.en_auxiliary: Ash Syndrome...? A disease caused by the Ash?
records.en: Ash Syndrome...? A disease caused by the Ash?

records.jp: そうです。治療法のない、病です
records.en_original: Yes. A disease without a cure.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. A disease without a cure.
records.en: Yes. A disease without a cure.

records.jp: わたしは、何人かの仲間と一緒に<CR>その灰がもたらす敵と戦っていました
records.en_original: My friends and I fought against the enemies that the Ash brought about.
records.en_auxiliary: My friends and I fought against the enemies that the Ash brought about.
records.en: My friends and I fought against the enemies that the Ash brought about.

records.jp: ……そうだ、そうだったのです。<CR>世界に灰が降って、大変なことになったのです
records.en_original: ...Right. That's right. Ash fell all over the world and caused terrible things to happen.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Right. That's right. Ash fell all over the world and caused terrible things to happen.
records.en: ...Right. That's right. Ash fell all over the world and caused terrible things to happen.

records.jp: 灰が積もった地域は人が住めなくなって、<CR>立ち入り禁止になったり……
records.en_original: The areas where Ash piled up were roped off, and people couldn't live there anymore...
records.en_auxiliary: The areas where Ash piled up were roped off, and people couldn't live there anymore...
records.en: The areas where Ash piled up were roped off, and people couldn't live there anymore...

records.jp: （私の知る限り、突然灰が降ってきたなんて<CR>ニュースは見たことがない）
records.en_original: (I don't remember seeing any news about Ash suddenly falling from the sky.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't remember seeing any news about Ash suddenly falling from the sky.)
records.en: (I don't remember seeing any news about Ash suddenly falling from the sky.)

records.jp: （世界中に降ったって言うんなら、<CR>一般人の私でも知っていておかしくないはず……）
records.en_original: (If it was falling all over the world, then I should remember it too...)
records.en_auxiliary: (If it was falling all over the world, then I should remember it too...)
records.en: (If it was falling all over the world, then I should remember it too...)

records.jp: なんで私は、知らないんだろう……？
records.en_original: Why don't I remember any of this...?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't I remember any of this...?
records.en: Why don't I remember any of this...?

records.jp: 星崎さんは、灰を知らないんですか？
records.en_original: You don't know about the Ash, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't know about the Ash, Ao?
records.en: You don't know about the Ash, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: う、うん
records.en_original: N-no.
records.en_auxiliary: N-no.
records.en: N-no.

records.jp: 実は愛央ちゃんも記憶を失ってる、とかかな？
records.en_original: Maybe you haven't gotten all your memories back yet?
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe you haven't gotten all your memories back yet?
records.en: Maybe you've actually lost your memories too, Ao-chan?

records.jp: そ、そんなことない……はず、なんだけどな……
records.en_original: I-I don't think that's it...but...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I don't think that's it...but...
records.en: I-I don't think that's it...but...

records.jp: あんまり気にすることないよ、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: You don't need to worry about it too much, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't need to worry about it too much, Ao.
records.en: You don't need to worry about it too much, Ao-chan.

records.jp: わたしも、詩帆ちゃんに言われて<CR>灰について思い出せたし……
records.en_original: I didn't remember it either until Shiho mentioned it.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't remember it either until Shiho mentioned it.
records.en: I didn't remember it either until Shiho-chan mentioned it.

records.jp: 星崎さんも、皆さんの記憶を取り戻す過程で<CR>何か思い出せるかもしれませんよ
records.en_original: Maybe you'll remember as we help everyone else get their memories back.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe you'll remember as we help everyone else get their memories back.
records.en: Maybe you'll remember something as we help everyone else recover their memories, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: ……まあ、それもそっか。<CR>分かんないことを考え続けてもしょうがないや！
records.en_original: ...Yeah, maybe. I guess it's not like I'll remember just by thinking about it.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah, maybe. I guess it's not like I'll remember just by thinking about it.
records.en: ...Yeah, maybe. I guess it's not like I'll remember just by thinking about it.

records.jp: 先に戻った勇希ちゃんと伶那ちゃんにも<CR>今の話、しておいた方がいいよね？
records.en_original: We should tell Yuki and Rena about this too, shouldn't we?
records.en_auxiliary: We should tell Yuki and Rena about this too, shouldn't we?
records.en: We should tell Yuki-chan and Rena-chan about this too, shouldn't we?

records.jp: うん。あとで教室に集まろう
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's all meet in the classroom later.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Let's all meet in the classroom later.
records.en: Yeah. Let's all meet in the classroom later.
